Dear [Dr Neale](../persons.html#1078),
I enclose postage stamps for the paper taken up by the Honolulu letters.[^2] Pray thank [Sister Anne](../persons.html#1816) for her kind note to me acknowledging the pin cushions.
yours faithfully

C M Yonge

[^1]: Black-edged paper.

[^2]: Queen [Emma](../persons.html#485) of Hawaii visited Hursley in August 1865, and the Honolulu letters may have been in connection with this.
